title: Fractal transference principle for continued fractions of Laurent series
summary: We establish a fractal transference principle for continued fraction expansions over the field of Laurent series. Let $S$ be an infinite subset of the set of all polynomials over a finite field of $q$ elements of positive degree with growth density exponent $α\ge 1$, and let $U \subset S$ be a subset of positive relative upper density.
